text: dsh-xiaoyi（DSH 插件，DSH 宿主）：把华为小艺 OpenClaw 模式接入本地 DSH 会话，让手机上的小艺消息进入本机 agent 并接收回复。插件在宿主注册后台通道、agent 工具和 HTTP 状态路由，通过华为云 WebSocket 连接并使用 AK、SK 与 agentId。主要功能包括查看连接状态、更新凭证并重连、向当前小艺任务发送文本，以及发送本地文件。适合希望从手机访问自己电脑上 DSH 会话的用户。使用前需准备小艺开放平台凭证；文件上传到 catbox.moe 仅在明确选择该模式时发生。

dsh-xiaoyi links Huawei XiaoYi with a local DSH session. It relays phone messages to the local agent and returns replies. Tools show status, update credentials, and send text or files. XiaoYi platform credentials are required. Files go to catbox.moe only when explicitly selected.
想用手机上的小艺和自己电脑里的 DSH agent 对话。
如何把华为小艺 OpenClaw 模式接到本地 DSH 会话？
我想从手机查看 DSH 通道是否在线并更新连接凭证。
dsh-xiaoyi 的功能「小艺接入本地会话」：插件连接华为小艺 WebSocket 通道，将小艺发来的请求交给本机 DSH 会话处理，并把会话回复回传。启用连接需要 AK、SK 和 agentId。
dsh-xiaoyi 的功能「管理通道并发送内容」：agent 可调用状态与设置工具检查连接、更新凭证或开关；当前小艺任务期间可主动发送短文本，也可用文件工具回传本地文件。
dsh-xiaoyi 使用前须知：连接需要 AK、SK 和 agentId；凭证状态和日志写入本机 ~/.dsh/xiaoyi/ 目录。（见 index.js:39-41、index.js:875-878）
dsh-xiaoyi 使用前须知：文件默认通过本机路由与用户配置的隧道提供；只有选择 catbox 模式时，文件才会上传到 catbox.moe。 (见 index.js:810-816、index.js:1214-1223)

dsh-xiaoyi README · dsh-xiaoyi：**English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A **DSH (DeepSeek Harness) host plugin** that connects **Huawei XiaoYi in OpenClaw mode** to your local DSH session — voice, text and images from your phone reach the agent running on your own machine.

> **This is not a standalone chatbot.** XiaoYi is only the entry point; what it connects to is your local DSH session (same tools, same working directory). There is no second agent.

dsh-xiaoyi README · dsh-xiaoyi：```
Huawei XiaoYi on your phone  (anywhere)
   │  voice / text / images
   ▼
Huawei Cloud  wss://hag.cloud.huawei.com/openclaw/v1/ws/link

---

dsh-xiaoyi README · Prerequisites：| # | Requirement | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **A DSH host** | DSH = DeepSeek Harness. This is a host-side plugin; without a host it cannot run. |
| 2 | **XiaoYi Open Platform credentials (OpenClaw mode)** | You need `AK` / `SK` / `agentId`. These are Huawei Cloud developer credentials you must apply for yourself on the XiaoYi Open Platform. |
| 3 | **Node.js ≥ 20** | The code uses the built-in `fetch` / `FormData` / `Blob`. Developed on Node 24. |

dsh-xiaoyi README · Prerequisites：> If you cannot obtain item 2, you can still read this repository as a **protocol reference implementation** — `index.js` implements the XiaoYi/OpenClaw handshake, auth, heartbeat and JSON-RPC message exchange in full.

dsh-xiaoyi README · Where do `AK` / `SK` / `agentId` come from?：**They are issued by Huawei. This project cannot create them for you and cannot tell you whether your account is eligible.** You have to apply for them yourself:

dsh-xiaoyi README · Where do `AK` / `SK` / `agentId` come from?：1. Register a **Huawei developer account** and complete **real-name verification** — <https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/register/>
2. Sign in to the **XiaoYi Open Platform** and create an agent — <https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/hag/hagindex.html#/>
   When creating it, choose the **OpenClaw mode**. Other modes are not compatible with this plugin.
3. Take the values from the agent's detail page:
   - `agentId` — shown in the **AgentCard** block;
   - `AK` / `SK` — under **Credentials → New credential**. **The SK is displayed only once**, so copy it immediately.
4. Add your own Huawei account to the agent's **test whitelist**. Until the agent is published, only whitelisted accounts can reach it; it takes effect after a few minutes.
5. Official documentation for this mode — <https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/doccenter-celia/openclaw-0000002518410344>

dsh-xiaoyi README · Where do `AK` / `SK` / `agentId` come from?：> Menu names, entry points and the review process are decided entirely by Huawei and may change at any time. If a step above no longer matches what you see, follow Huawei's own documentation rather than this file.
> This plugin only **consumes** the three credentials. It never asks Huawei for anything else on your behalf.

---

dsh-xiaoyi README · Features：- **Zero third-party dependencies.** Only Node built-ins are used, including a **hand-written minimal WebSocket client** (RFC6455 client side: text frames, fragmentation reassembly, ping/pong, and handshake verification). Fewer packages in the plugin tree means fewer chances that one failed package takes the whole host down.
- **Complete protocol implementation.** Auth signing, init handshake, heartbeat with stale-connection detection, JSON-RPC 2.0 streaming, and control messages (`clearContext` / `tasks/cancel`).
- **Inbound attachments.** Images and files sent from XiaoYi are downloaded to disk, and their local paths are handed to the agent in the session (ready for `read_image` / `read`).
- **Outbound online files (experimental).** Send local files back to XiaoYi (the protocol only accepts public https URLs; supports a local tunnel or a third-party image host). See the direction table below — this direction is **not** reliable.
- **Session reuse.** On a cold start the plugin resumes the existing session instead of opening a new conversation every time.

dsh-xiaoyi README · What can travel in each direction：| Direction | Support | | --- | --- | | **Phone → this plugin**
(what you send to XiaoYi) | **Text, voice (transcribed) and images/files all work.** Attachments are downloaded to `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/media/` and their local paths are handed to the agent. | | **This plugin → phone**
(what you get back in XiaoYi) | **Text works** — the reply body, plus anything sent with `xiaoyi_send`. **Pushing an image or file back to the phone is unreliable**: the protocol accepts only a public https URL, and the XiaoYi client is not guaranteed to render the file part. Treat `xiaoyi_send_photo` as experimental. |
section: What can travel in each direction

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "ak": "XiaoYi Open Platform AK",
  "sk": "XiaoYi Open Platform SK",

dsh-xiaoyi README · 4. Provide credentials：| Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `enabled` | Master switch. `false` disconnects the channel. |
| `ak` / `sk` / `agentId` | XiaoYi Open Platform credentials. All three are required. |
| `wsUrl` | WebSocket endpoint. Leave as the default unless Huawei changes it. |
| `sessionId` | The DSH session to reuse. Normally written by the plugin itself. |
| `cwd` | Working directory for the session. Must be writable. |
| `publicBaseUrl` | Only for outbound files in `local` mode: the public https base URL of your tunnel. |
| `imageHost` | Optional default publisher for outbound files. Set `"catbox"` to make catbox.moe the default; leave empty to stay local-only. |

dsh-xiaoyi README · 4. Provide credentials：You can also let the agent configure these at runtime with the `xiaoyi_set` tool (changes take effect immediately and reconnect).

Log file: `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/xiaoyi.log`

---

dsh-xiaoyi README · Agent tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `xiaoyi_status` | Channel status: whether credentials are complete, whether the WebSocket is connected, the listening session id, queue length, last error, message counters. |
| `xiaoyi_set` | Update credentials / switch (`ak`, `sk`, `agentId`, `wsUrl`, `enabled`). Takes effect immediately on the live connection. |
| `xiaoyi_send` | Push a short message to the current XiaoYi conversation (useful as a long-task completion notice). |
| `xiaoyi_send_photo` | Send a local image or file to XiaoYi (the protocol only accepts public https; see "Outbound files" below). |
| `xiaoyi_reconnect` | Force a disconnect and reconnect (after changing credentials, or when the link looks stale). |

dsh-xiaoyi README · HTTP routes：| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /xiaoyi/state` | JSON status. |
| `GET /xiaoyi/connect` | Start the channel and make sure the listening session is ready. |
| `GET /xiaoyi/disconnect` | Stop the channel. |
| `GET /xiaoyi/public/<filename>` | Serves published outbound files. Filenames carry a random component and are not guessable. |

---
dsh-xiaoyi README · Protocol summary：> Verified against the published artifacts of `@ynhcj/xiaoyi`. This project does not depend on that package.

dsh-xiaoyi README · Protocol summary：| Stage | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Endpoint | `wss://hag.cloud.huawei.com/openclaw/v1/ws/link` |
| Auth headers | `x-access-key`=AK, `x-sign`=`Base64(HMAC-SHA256(SK, ts))`, `x-ts`=milliseconds, `x-agent-id`=agentId |
| Handshake | `{"msgType":"clawd_bot_init","agentId":"..."}` |
| Heartbeat | Every 30s `{"msgType":"heartbeat","agentId":"...","timestamp":...}` plus a protocol-level ping |
| Inbound | JSON-RPC 2.0, `method="message/stream"`; `sessionId=params.sessionId`, `taskId=params.id`, `messageId`=top-level `id`; text in `params.message.parts[kind=text].text`, attachments in `parts[kind=file].file{name,mimeType,uri}` |
| Outbound | `{"msgType":"agent_response", agentId, sessionId, taskId, msgDetail:"<JSON-RPC string>"}` |
| Outbound frame kinds | `result.kind="status-update"` (acknowledge with `state=working`), `result.kind="artifact-update"` (the body, closed with `lastChunk=true, final=true`) |
| Control | `clearContext` / `tasks/cancel` / `action="clear"` → reply with the matching JSON-RPC response |

dsh-xiaoyi README · Outbound files (`xiaoyi_send_photo`)：The Part sent back to the client is `{ url, filename, mediaType }` — **only public https URLs are accepted; there is no "upload bytes" interface**. Hence two modes:

dsh-xiaoyi README · Outbound files (`xiaoyi_send_photo`)：| mode | Behaviour | Privacy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `local` (**default**) | The file is copied to `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/public/` and served by this plugin's own route; pair it with a tunnel (e.g. `localhost.run`) and point `state.publicBaseUrl` at it. | The file never leaves your machine (except through your tunnel). |
| `catbox` | Uploads to the third-party host `catbox.moe`. | **The file is sent to a third party.** Must be requested explicitly. |

dsh-xiaoyi README · Outbound files (`xiaoyi_send_photo`)：`local` mode requires `state.publicBaseUrl`; without it the tool returns an error and **never** silently falls back to an image host.

---

dsh-xiaoyi README · Security and privacy：- **Credentials stay local.** They live in `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/state.json`, which is excluded by `.gitignore`. They are never committed and never logged (the log only records whether a value is present).
- **Inbound attachments are protected against SSRF.** The inbound `uri` comes from an external message and is treated as untrusted input. Only `http`/`https` is allowed. Every hop of a redirect chain is checked **before it is fetched** (`redirect: 'manual'`), and each host is judged two ways: structurally, and by **what it actually resolves to**. IPv6 addresses are parsed into bytes rather than compared as strings, so equivalent spellings cannot slip through. Blocked ranges: loopback, private, link-local, unique-local, multicast, site-local, IPv4-mapped (`::ffff:a.b.c.d`), NAT64, 6to4 and Teredo — including cloud metadata endpoints such as `169.254.169.254`.
- **Attachments are size-capped.** 50 MB per file, read as a stream, so a lying `content-length` cannot exhaust memory.
- **Published URLs are unguessable.** Filenames include 8 random bytes.
- ⚠️ **The HTTP routes themselves have no authentication.** `/xiaoyi/state` and `/xiaoyi/public/*` ar

dsh-xiaoyi README · Known limitations：- **A file or image cannot be pushed back to the phone reliably.** The protocol only accepts a public https URL for outbound files, and whether the XiaoYi client renders the resulting file part is outside this project's control. Text replies are unaffected.
- **Outbound attachments must use a public URL.** This is a protocol constraint, not a shortcut in the implementation.
- **Inbound attachment URLs are pre-signed and expire in roughly 30 minutes**, so they must be fetched immediately. This plugin does exactly that; if a download fails, the link has most likely expired.
- **The `media/` directory is never cleaned automatically.** Prune `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/media/` yourself periodically.
- **Platform-side policies may change.** OpenClaw mode, endpoints and field names can be adjusted by Huawei at any time; long-term availability is not guaranteed.

dsh-xiaoyi README · Uninstall：1. Remove `dsh-xiaoyi` from `bundles` and `dependencies` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`.
2. `dsh plugin --profile web install`
3. Cold-start the host.
4. For a complete cleanup, delete `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/` (it contains credentials and logs).

---

dsh-xiaoyi README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | What to check |
| --- | --- |
| Nothing happens after installing | Did you **cold-start**? Host-side plugins are not applied by hot reload. |
| `status` reports `ready:false` | One of AK / SK / agentId is missing. |
| Cannot connect, `lastError` mentions a handshake failure | Is `wsUrl` correct? Can the machine reach `hag.cloud.huawei.com:443`? |
| Connects then keeps reconnecting | Look for "stale connection" in the log; if nothing (including pong) arrives for over 90 seconds the plugin reconnects on purpose. |
| XiaoYi messages get no reply | Check `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/xiaoyi.log` and confirm in the host log that the plugin loaded. |
| Reply says the DSH session is not ready | The very first request after a host start has to create the session; send the message again shortly after. |
| Sent images do not arrive | This direction is unreliable by design — see "What can travel in each direction". The protocol also requires a public https URL, so check `publicBaseUrl` and whether your tunnel is still alive. |

把「**小艺开放平台 · OpenClaw 模式**」的通道实现成 **DSH 插件**：手机上的小艺（语音/文字/图片）直接对话到你本机运行的 DSH 会话。

> **这不是一个独立的聊天机器人。** 它只是"入口"，小艺连进来的是你本机那套 DSH 会话（同一套工具、同一份工作目录）。没有第二个 agent。

```
手机小艺（在哪都行）
   │  语音 / 文字 / 图片
   ▼
华为云  wss://hag.cloud.huawei.com/openclaw/v1/ws/link

---

dsh-xiaoyi README · 前置条件（先看完再装）：这个东西**不是开箱即用的**，装之前请确认三件事：

| # | 条件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **你有一个 DSH 宿主** | DSH = DeepSeek Harness。本插件是宿主侧插件，没有宿主它跑不起来 |
| 2 | **你有小艺开放平台的 OpenClaw 模式凭证** | 需要 `AK` / `SK` / `agentId` 三样。这是华为云侧的开发者凭证，需要你自己去小艺开放平台申请开通 |
| 3 | **Node.js ≥ 20** | 代码用了内置的 `fetch` / `FormData` / `Blob`。开发环境是 Node 24 |

> 如果你拿不到第 2 项，也可以把这个仓库当成**协议实现参考**来读——`index.js` 里把 OpenClaw 的握手、鉴权、心跳、JSON-RPC 收发都写全了。

dsh-xiaoyi README · `AK` / `SK` / `agentId` 到底去哪儿搞？：1. 注册**华为开发者账号**并完成**实名认证**——<https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/register/>
2. 登录**小艺开放平台**，创建一个智能体——<https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/hag/hagindex.html#/>
   创建时**必须选「OpenClaw 模式」**，别的模式跟本插件不兼容。
3. 在智能体详情页取三样东西：
   - `agentId`——在 **AgentCard** 模块里；
   - `AK` / `SK`——左侧**「凭证管理」→「新建凭证」**。**SK 只显示一次**，当场复制存好。
4. 把你自己的华为账号加进智能体的**「测试管理」→「测试白名单」**。上架之前只有白名单里的账号能访问，大约几分钟后生效。
5. 这个模式的官方文档——<https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/doccenter-celia/openclaw-0000002518410344>

dsh-xiaoyi README · `AK` / `SK` / `agentId` 到底去哪儿搞？：> 菜单名、入口位置、审核流程**全部由华为决定，随时可能变**。上面哪一步跟你看的对不上，请以华为官方文档为准，别以这份文件为准。
> 本插件只**使用**这三样凭证，不会替你去跟华为要任何别的东西。

---

dsh-xiaoyi README · 特性：- **零第三方依赖**：只用 Node 内置模块，**自己手写了 WebSocket 客户端**（RFC6455 客户端侧：文本帧、分片重组、ping/pong、握手校验）。
  插件树里少一个包，就少一次「某个包加载失败 → 整个宿主起不来」的风险。
- **完整协议实现**：鉴权签名、初始化握手、心跳与假死检测、JSON-RPC 2.0 流式收发、控制类消息（clearContext / tasks/cancel）。
- **入站附件自动落地**：小艺发来的图片/文件自动下载到本地，再把路径交给会话里的 agent（可直接 `read_image` / `read`）。
- **出站在线文件（实验性）**：把本地文件发回小艺（协议只接受公网 https URL，支持本机隧道或第三方图床两种方式）。**这个方向不可靠**，见下面的方向表。
- **会话复用**：冷启动优先 resume 原来那条会话，不重复新开对话。

dsh-xiaoyi README · 两个方向分别能传什么：| 方向 | 支持情况 | | --- | --- | | **手机 → 本插件**
（你发给小艺的） | **文字、语音（转成文字）、图片/文件都可以。** 附件会下载到 `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/media/`，再把本地路径交给会话里的 agent | | **本插件 → 手机**
（小艺回给你的） | **文字可以**——回复正文，以及 `xiaoyi_send` 推的短消息。**图片/文件推回手机不可靠**：协议只接受公网 https URL，而且小艺客户端不保证把文件渲染出来。`xiaoyi_send_photo` 请当成实验性功能 | > 一句话：**入站方向才是靠得住的。** 如果你的用法依赖"图片能回到手机上"，别指望它。 ---

| `GET /xiaoyi/state` | JSON 状态 |

dsh-xiaoyi README · 协议要点：| 环节 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 连接 | `wss://hag.cloud.huawei.com/openclaw/v1/ws/link` |
| 鉴权请求头 | `x-access-key`=AK、`x-sign`=`Base64(HMAC-SHA256(SK, ts))`、`x-ts`=毫秒、`x-agent-id`=agentId |
| 握手 | `{"msgType":"clawd_bot_init","agentId":"..."}` |
| 心跳 | 每 30s `{"msgType":"heartbeat","agentId":"...","timestamp":...}` + 协议层 ping |
| 入站 | JSON-RPC 2.0，`method="message/stream"`；`sessionId=params.sessionId`、`taskId=params.id`、`messageId`=顶层 `id`；文本在 `params.message.parts[kind=text].text`，附件在 `parts[kind=file].file{name,mimeType,uri}` |
| 出站 | `{"msgType":"agent_response", agentId, sessionId, taskId, msgDetail:"<JSON-RPC 字符串>"}` |
| 出站帧类型 | `result.kind="status-update"`（先回执 `state=working`）、`result.kind="artifact-update"`（正文，`lastChunk=true, final=true` 收尾） |
| 控制 | `clearContext` / `tasks/cancel` / `action="clear"` → 回对应 JSON-RPC response |

dsh-xiaoyi README · 出站文件（`xiaoyi_send_photo`）：协议回给端侧的 Part 是 `{ url, filename, mediaType }` —— **只接受公网 https 地址，没有"上传字节"的接口**。所以有两种模式：

| mode | 行为 | 隐私 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `local`（**默认**） | 复制到 `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/public/`，由本插件自己的路由对外提供，再配合一条隧道（如 `localhost.run`）把 `state.publicBaseUrl` 指过来 | 文件不出本机（除了隧道） |
| `catbox` | 上传到第三方图床 `catbox.moe` | **文件会被传到第三方**，必须显式指定才启用 |

配 `state.publicBaseUrl` 之后 `local` 模式才能用；没配就直接报错，**不会**偷偷回退到图床。

dsh-xiaoyi README · 安全与隐私：- **凭证只存在本地** `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/state.json`，已被 `.gitignore` 排除，不进仓库、不进日志（日志只记录"有/无"）。
- **入站附件有 SSRF 防护**：入站 `uri` 来自外部消息，属于不可信输入。只允许 `http/https`；重定向的**每一跳都在发请求之前**先检查（用 `redirect: 'manual'` 自己跟），而且每台主机要过**两道关**：结构检查 + **它实际解析到什么地址**。IPv6 是按字节解析的，不做字符串前缀比较，所以同义写法绕不过去。拦掉的段：环回、私网、链路本地、唯一本地、多播、站点本地、IPv4-mapped（`::ffff:a.b.c.d`）、NAT64、6to4、Teredo —— 含 `169.254.169.254` 这类云元数据地址。
- **附件有体积闸门**：单文件上限 50 MB，流式读取，对方少报 `content-length` 也不会把内存打爆。
- **出站公开链接不可猜**：文件名带 8 字节随机串。
- ⚠️ **HTTP 路由本身没有鉴权**。`/xiaoyi/state`、`/xiaoyi/public/*` 谁都能访问。请**不要**把 DSH 的端口裸奔到公网；要走隧道的话，用带鉴权/随机域名的方案。

dsh-xiaoyi README · 已知限制：- **图片/文件推回手机不可靠**：协议只接受公网 https URL，而且文件发出去之后小艺客户端会不会渲染出来，不在本插件的控制范围内。文字回复不受影响。
- **出站附件必须走公网 URL**：这是协议限制，不是实现偷懒。
- **入站附件链接是预签名的、大约 30 分钟过期**：所以必须"一到就抓"。本插件就是这么做的；如果下载失败，基本就是链接已经过期。
- **`media/` 目录不会自动清理**：长期使用请自己定期清理 `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/media/`。
- **平台侧策略可能变**：OpenClaw 模式、地址、字段都可能随华为侧调整而失效，本插件不保证长期可用。

dsh-xiaoyi README · 排错：| 现象 | 排查方向 |
| --- | --- |
| 装完没反应 | **冷启动**了吗？宿主端插件热重载不生效 |
| `status` 里 `ready:false` | AK / SK / agentId 有缺项 |
| 一直连不上、`lastError` 有握手错误 | `wsUrl` 是否被改错；网络是否能到 `hag.cloud.huawei.com:443` |
| 连上又断、反复重连 | 看日志里的"连接假死"；超过 90 秒没有任何回音（含 pong）会主动重连 |
| 小艺发消息没回应 | 看 `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/xiaoyi.log`；确认宿主日志里插件是否加载成功 |
| 收到「DSH 会话未就绪」 | 宿主启动后第一次请求要现建会话，稍等再发一次 |
| 发的图片收不到 | 这个方向本来就是不可靠的，见「两个方向分别能传什么」。协议还要求公网 https，检查 `publicBaseUrl` 有没有配、隧道还活着吗 |
